2023 
Author: Kuldeep Mathur
Bench: Kuldeep Mathur
[2023/Rjjd/016148]
 High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan At
 Jodhpur
 S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 5390/2023
Baldev Ram S/o Sh. Hukma Ram, Aged About 28 Years, R/o
Butati, Kuchera P.s., Dist. Nagaur.
 (Lodged In Dist. Jail, Bhilwara).
 ----Petitioner
 Versus
State Of Rajasthan, Through P.P.
 ----Respondent
For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Jagatveer Singh Deora.
For Respondent(s) : Mr. S.K. Bhati, P.P.
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Kuldeep Mathur
Order 18/05/2023 This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the
petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.213/2021, registered at Police Station
Gangapur, District Bhilwara, for offences under Sections 363, 344-A, 376-D of the Ipc and Section
5/6 & 16/17 of the Pocso Act.

entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan At
 Jodhpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the materials available on record.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that similarly situated co-accused namely Shrawan Ram, Dharmendra @ Dharma and Budharam have already been enlarged on bail by the coordinate Benches of this Court vide orders dated 14.12.2021 (in CRLMB Nos.13424/2021 & 12208/2021) and 16.03.2022 (in CRLMB No.3583/2022) respectively, and the case of present petitioner is not distinguishable from those of the co-accused.

The [2023/RJJD/016148] (2 of 2)
[CRLMB-5390/2023] petitioner is in judicial custody and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time, therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused-petitioner.
Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.

Having considered the rival Baldev Ram vs State Of Rajasthan (2023/Rjjd/016148) on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/194005687/
1 submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the bail application filed by the petitioner deserves to be accepted.

entities.text: Baldev Ram vs State Of Rajasthan (2023/Rjjd/016148)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Consequently, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioner Baldev Ram S/o Sh. Hukma Ram arrested in connection with F.I.R.
No.213/2021, registered at Police Station Gangapur, District Bhilwara, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.1,00,000/- and two sureties of Rs.50,000/- each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for his appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 124-Prashant/-
